SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, TARGET AS PLANT, KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO, KEY_2 AS QUOTATION_SEQ FROM KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RE' AND KEY_7 IN (' ','T')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KOL3' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, ISNULL(TARGET,' ') AS PLANT, ISNULL(KEY_1,' ') AS QUOTATION_NO, ISNULL(KEY_2,' ') AS QUOTATION_SEQ, ISNULL(REVISION_NO,'01') AS REVISION, ISNULL(STATUS,' ') AS STATUS, ISNULL(ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, ISNULL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, ISNULL(DESCRIPTION,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, ISNULL(SPECIFICATION,' ') AS SPECIFICATION, ISNULL(UNIT_MEASURE,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, ISNULL(MAKER_NAME,' ') AS MAKER_NAME, ISNULL(UNIT_PRICE, 0) AS PREV_UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(REQ_USER_ID,' ') AS ADD_USER_ID, ISNULL(REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, ISNULL(REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT, ISNULL(REQ_USER_TELNO,' ') AS REQ_USER_TEL, ISNULL(REQ_USER_MAIL,' ') AS REQ_USER_MAIL, ISNULL(CLOSE_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, ISNULL(CLOSE_DATE,' ') AS CLOSE_DATE, ISNULL(CLOSE_TIME,' ') AS CLOSE_TIME, ISNULL(ITEM_QTY, 0) AS ITEM_QTY, ISNULL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM V_KEP_RE LEFT JOIN KEPTRXL ON KEPTRXL.TARGET = V_KEP_RE.PLANT AND KEPTRXL.KEY_1 = V_KEP_RE.QUOTATION_NO AND KEPTRXL.KEY_2 = V_KEP_RE.QUOTATION_SEQ AND KEPTRXL.DOC_NAME= '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEPTRXL.KEY_7 IN (' ','T') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEY_7 IN (' ','T') AND TARGET = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' ORDER BY TARGET,KEY_1,KEY_2
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET KEY_7 = 'Y', KEY_6 = GETDATE() WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEY_7 IN (' ','T') AND TARGET = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$'
